harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «تبارك الذي»: a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). «للعالمين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) «نذيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الذي» is a badal (substitute) of the preceding relative noun. «ولدًا» is the second object, and the implied (muqaddar) «أحدًا» is the first object. The clause «ولم يتخذ» is conjoined to the clause «له ملك». The preposition «في الملك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شريك»; the preposition «له» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «يكن». The clause «له ملك» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the clause «ولم يكن له شريك» is conjoined to the clause «له ملك».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The clause «واتخذوا» is resumptive; the preposition «من دونه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «اتخذ». The clause «لا يخلقون» is a naʿt (adjective) of «آلهة», and the clause «وهم يخلقون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يخلقون».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «إنْ» is negating; «هذا إفك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr). The clause «افتراه» is a naʿt (adjective). «ظلمًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the verb «جاء» sometimes being transitive by itself.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «أساطير»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هي. The clause «اكتتبها» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أساطير»; the clause «فهي تملى» is conjoined to the clause «اكتتبها». «بكرة» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «تملى».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «مال هذا»: «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «الرسول» is a badal (substitute), and the clause «يأكل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرسول». «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the clause after it is resumptive within the scope of the saying. The fāʾ in «فيكون» is causal (sababiyya), and the verb is in the subjunctive by an implied «أن»; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. هلا كان نزول ملك فكونه معه نذيرا (why was there not the descent of an angel, and his being a warner with him?).

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «وقال الظالمون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause {وَقَالُوا}. «إنْ» is negating.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «ضربوا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the [verb of] looking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative, which carries the sense of knowing. The clause «فلا يستطيعون» is conjoined to the clause «ضلوا».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The preposition «لك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل»; the preposition «من ذلك» is attached to «خيرًا»; «جنات» is a badal (substitute) of «خيرًا». «ويجعلْ» is jussive (majzūm), conjoined to the position of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «كذبوا» is resumptive. The clause «وأعتدنا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: (إذا رأتهم من مكان بعيد) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is a naʿt (adjective) of {سَعِيرًا}, which is feminine.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause. «مكانًا» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ألقوا»; the preposition «منها» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «مكانًا», having originally been an adjective of it. «مقرَّنين» is a ḥāl of the wāw in «ألقوا». «هنالك» is a demonstrative, an adverb of place attached to «دَعَوا». «ثبورا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because they say: يا ثبوراه (O destruction!).

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: The clause «لا تدعوا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of an implied verb of saying.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «جنة»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ذلك»; «التي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الجنة». The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «جزاء». The clause «كانت» is a ḥāl of «جنة الخلد».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached. «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يشاءون». The preposition «على ربك» is attached to a ḥāl of «وَعْدًا». The clause «لهم فيها ما يشاءون» is a second ḥāl of «جنة الخلد», and the clause «كان وعدًا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction; «يوم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause is conjoined to the preceding clause {قُلْ}. The preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied returning pronoun, i.e. ما يعبدونه كائنًا من دون الله (what they worship, being other than Allah). «هؤلاء» is a naʿt (adjective) interpreted as a derived word, i.e. المشار إليهم (those pointed to). The clause «هم ضلُّوا» is conjoined to the clause «أأنتم أضللتم».

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The noun of kāna is the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). The interpreted maṣdar «أن نتخذ» is the fāʿil (agent) of «ينبغي»; the preposition «من دونك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «نتخذ»; the second «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida), and «أولياء» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «ما كان ينبغي» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «ولكن متعتهم» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying). «وآباءهم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the hāʾ. The interpreted maṣdar «أنْ نسوا» is genitive, attached to «متعتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فقد كذَّبوكم» is resumptive, and the clause «فما تستطيعون» is conjoined to the clause «كذَّبوكم». The clause «ومن يظلم» is resumptive; «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يظلم»; «عذابًا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The clause «وما أرسلنا» is resumptive. The preposition «من المرسلين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of the implied object, i.e. أحدًا كائنًا من المرسلين (anyone among the messengers); «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr). The clause «إنهم ليأكلون» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «المرسلين». The preposition «لبعض» is attached to a ḥāl of «فتنة». The clause «أتصبرون» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «وكان ...».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «وقال» is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); the clause «نرى» is conjoined to the clause «أنزل»; and the clause «لقد استكبروا» is the response to an implied oath. «عَتَوا»: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied ḍamma on the alif that was dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: «يوم» is an object of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause is resumptive; the clause «يرون» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «يوم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of «لا», and «إذٍ» is muḍāf ilayhi, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, its tanwīn compensating for a clause. The preposition «للمجرمين» is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. «حجرًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, and «محجورًا» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «حجرًا محجورا» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition «من عمل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما»; «هباء» is the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The adverb «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); «إذٍ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «مستقرًا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction; «يوم» is an object of an implied اذكر (remember), and the clause is conjoined to the implied اذكر in verse (22). The clause «تشقق» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «الملك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is what the preposition «للرحمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq). «يوم» is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. «الحق» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الملك». The noun of kāna is the pronoun of «اليوم», and «يومًا» is its khabar; the preposition «على الكافرين» is attached to «عسيرًا»; «عسيرا» is a naʿt of «يومًا». The clause «وكان يومًا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «الملك للرحمن».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «ويوم»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «يوم» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «يوم» in verse (25); the implied sense is: واذكر يوم تشقق ويوم يَعَضُّ (remember the day it splits and the day he bites). The preposition «على يديه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعض». «يا» is for drawing attention (tanbīh); «مع» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the second object; and the clause «يقول» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الظالم». [Translator's note: the quotation marks are misplaced in the source text; the reading above follows the evident sense.]

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «يا ويلتى»: a vocative (munādā) in a genitive construct, accusative with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ that was changed into an alif; this alif is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause «ليتني لم أتخذ» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «لقد أضلَّني» is the response to an oath. «إذ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the clause «جاءني» is muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «وكان الشيطان خذولا» is resumptive; the preposition «للإنسان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خذولا».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «وقال» is resumptive; the clause «إن قومي اتخذوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive; «مهجورا» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: (وكذلك جعلنا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The wāw is resumptive; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the demonstrative is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the implied sense being: جعلنا جَعْلا مثلَ ذلك الجعل (We made a making like that making). The clause «جعلنا» is resumptive, and the preposition «لكل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object. The preposition «من المجرمين» is attached to «عدوا». The wāw in «وكفى» is resumptive, the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), «ربك» is the fāʿil (agent), and «هاديًا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «جملةً» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «القرآن». The kāf in «كذلك» is a preposition, and «ذا» is a genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. الأمر كذلك (the matter is thus). The genitive interpreted maṣdar in «لنثبت» is attached to an omitted verb, i.e. فَعَلْنا ذلك لنثبت (We did that in order to make firm). The clause «الأمر كذلك» is resumptive, the implied clause «فعلنا» is resumptive, and the clause «ورتَّلْناه» is conjoined to the implied clause «فعلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «ولا يأتونك» is resumptive; the clause «جئناك» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «يأتونك»; the preposition «بالحق» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «جئناك»; «أحسن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الحق»; and «تفسيرًا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «الذين» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «أولئك شر», and the clause is resumptive. The preposition «على وجوههم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition «إلى جهنم» is attached to «يحشرون»; «مكانًا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The wāw in «ولقد» is resumptive; «معه» is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعلنا»; «هارون» is a badal (substitute).

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «فقلنا» is conjoined to the clause «جعلنا», and the clause «فدمَّرناهم» is conjoined to an implied clause, i.e. فكذَّبوهما فدمَّرناهم (they belied them both, so We destroyed them).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «وقوم نوح»: the wāw is resumptive, and «قوم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «اذكر» (remember); the clause «واذكر» is resumptive. «لما» is a particle of necessity upon necessity (wujūb li-wujūb). The preposition «للناس» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آية». The conditional clause is a ḥāl of «قوم نوح», and the clause «أغرقناهم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The clause «وأعتدنا» is conjoined to the clause «جعلناهم».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «وعادًا»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «قوم». The adverb «بين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «قرونًا», and «كثيرًا» is a second naʿt of «قرونًا».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: «وكلا»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «كلا» is an object of an omitted verb explained by what follows, its implied form being «أنذرنا كلا» (We warned each). The implied clause is conjoined to the clause «أعتدنا», and the clause «ضربنا» is explicative (tafsīriyya). The second «كلا» is an object placed before «تَبَّر».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The clause «ولقد أتَوْا» is resumptive; «التي» is a naʿt (adjective); «مطر» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «أفلم يكونوا» is conjoined to the clause «أتوا»; the clause «كانوا» is resumptive; and «بل» is for iḍrāb (digression).

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «إنْ» is negating; «هزوًا» is the second object. «إذا» is an adverbial conditional particle (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied clause «قالوا». «رسولا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied returning pronoun, i.e. بعثه رسولا (He sent him as a messenger). The clause «إنْ يتخذونك» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa); the implied clause «قالوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); and the clause «أهذا الذي» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) of the implied «قالوا».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: «إنْ» is lightened (mukhaffafa) and inoperative (muhmala); «كاد» is an abrogating verb (nāsikha), and its noun is the pronoun هو; the clause is resumptive within the scope of negation. The lām is the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and the clause «ليضلنا» is the khabar (predicate) of kāda. «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); «أَنْ» and what follows it are interpreted as a maṣdar, a mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being موجود (exists). The clause «لولا صبرُنا موجود» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «وسوف يعلمون» is resumptive; «حين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يعلمون». «مَنْ أَضَلُّ»: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause fills the place of the two objects of «يعلمون», which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «مَنْ» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The two objects of «اتخذ» are «إلهه هواه». The fāʾ in «فأنت» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «وكيلا». The clause «أفأنت تكون» is the second object of «أرأيت».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the interpreted maṣdar fills the place of the two objects of «حسب». The clause «إن هم إلا كالأنعام» is resumptive, and «إنْ» is negating. The clause «بل هم أضل» is resumptive, and «سبيلا» is a tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial). The clause «كيف مدَّ» is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) of «ربك». The clause «ولو شاء لجعله» is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). The clause «ثم جعلنا» is conjoined to the clause «مدَّ»; the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl of «دليلا».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «ثم قبضناه» is conjoined to the clause {جَعَلْنَا}, in the position of the genitive.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause {أَلَمْ تَرَ}; the preposition «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل». As for «والنوم سباتا»: «النوم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الليل», and «سباتا» is conjoined to «لباسًا».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the preceding clause «هو الذي»; «بشرًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرياح»; «بين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسل».

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The genitive interpreted maṣdar «لنحيي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أنزلنا». The preposition «مما» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أنعامًا», and «أنعامًا» is the first object of «نسقيه»; the implied sense is: ونسقي أنعامًا كائنة من الذي خلقناه الماء (and We give the water to drink to cattle, being among what We created). «أناسيّ» is the plural of إنسان; its original form is أناسين; the nūn was changed into yāʾ, and the yāʾ before it was assimilated into it.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «ولقد صَرَّفْناه» is conjoined to the clause {وَأَنْزَلْنَا}, and the clause «فأبى» is conjoined to the clause «صَرَّفْناه». «كفورًا» is the object of «أبى»; the exception is emptied (mufarragh), preceded by the sense of negation in «أبى».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: (ولو شئنا لبعثنا في كل قرية نذيرا) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the clause {وَهُوَ الَّذِي} in verse (48). The clause «هذا عذب» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «البحرين», and the adverb «بينهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The clause «فجعله» is conjoined to the clause «خلق», and the clause «وكان ربك قديرا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «ويعبدون» is resumptive; the preposition «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما», and «ما» is a relative noun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «وكان ...» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وما أرسلناك» is resumptive; «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr); «مبشِّرًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the kāf.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida), and «أجر» is the second object; the preposition «عليه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أجر». «إلا» is for exception; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, a disconnected excepted (mustathnā munqaṭiʿ). The preposition «إلى ربه» is attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective). The preposition «بحمده» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «سبِّح», i.e. ملتبسًا «بحمده» (accompanied by His praise). The bāʾ after «كفى» is redundant (zāʾida), and the hāʾ is the fāʿil. The preposition «بذنوب» is attached to «خبيرًا»; «خبيرًا» is a tamyīz (specification). The clause «كفى به» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: «الذي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is «الرحمن». The adverb «بينهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The fāʾ in «فاسأل» is resumptive. The bāʾ in «به» is attached to «خبيرًا»; «خبيرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «اسأل».

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw is resumptive, as is the conditional clause. The preposition «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قيل», and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of the maṣdar. The maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) after «قالوا» is implied, i.e. نسجد. «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الرحمن» is the khabar (predicate). The lām is a preposition of cause, and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), the maṣdar being genitive, i.e. أنسجد لأمرك؟ (shall we prostrate because of your command?). The fāʿil (agent) of «زادهم» is the pronoun of the saying; «نفورا» is the second object. The clause «أنسجد» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the clause «وزادهم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The preposition «في السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: The clause «وهو الذي» is conjoined to the preceding clause {تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي}. «خلفة» is the second object. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يذَّكَّر» is the object of «أراد».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: The clause «وعباد الرحمن ...» is resumptive, and the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) will come in verse (75). «هونًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. مشيًا هَوْنًا (a gentle walking). The conditional clause is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause). «سلامًا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. نسلِّم سلامًا (we greet with a greeting of peace); it is thus a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar), the maṣdar being تسليم.

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: The relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun. «يبيتون» is an abrogating (nāsikh) imperfect verb with its noun; the khabar (predicate) is «سُجَّدًا», and the preposition «لربهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:65-65.t: The clause «إن عذابها كان غرامًا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:66-66.t: «مستقرًا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the [noun] specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. جهنم (Hell).

harrat-mujtaba:67-67.t: The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The noun of kāna is the pronoun of the spending; «بين» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قواما».

harrat-mujtaba:68-68.t: The relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding one. «مع» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «إلهًا»; the preposition «بالحق» is attached to a ḥāl of the wāw in «يقتلون». The conditional clause is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:69-69.t: The clause «يضاعَفْ» is a badal (substitute) of the clause {يَلْقَ}. «مهانًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يخلد».

harrat-mujtaba:70-70.t: «مَنْ» is a relative noun, a connected excepted (mustathnā muttaṣil); «عملا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فأولئك يبدل» is resumptive, and the two objects of «يبدّل» are the two accusative nouns.

harrat-mujtaba:71-71.t: The clause «ومَنْ تاب» is resumptive; «صالحًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «متابا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and it is a mīmī maṣdar (maṣdar mīmī).

harrat-mujtaba:72-72.t: The relative noun is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the one preceding in verse (68), and «كرامًا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «مرُّوا».

harrat-mujtaba:73-73.t: The conditional clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; «صُمًّا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw in «يخرُّوا».

harrat-mujtaba:74-74.t: The clause «هب» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. The preposition «من أزواجنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «قرة», and the preposition «للمتقين» is attached to a ḥāl of «إمامًا».

harrat-mujtaba:75-75.t: The clause «أولئك يجزون» is the khabar (predicate) of «عباد» in verse (63). The demonstrative is a mubtadaʾ (subject); «الغرفة» is the second object; the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the genitive maṣdar is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; «تحية» is the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:76-76.t: «خالدين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) in {يُجْزَوْنَ}; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خالدين». «مستقرًا» is a tamyīz (specification), and the [noun] specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e. الغرفة. The clause «حَسُنت» is a ḥāl of {الْغُرْفَةَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:77-77.t: «ما» is negating; «ربي» is the fāʿil (agent). «لولا» is a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), and «دعاؤكم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being موجود (exists). The conditional clause is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The clause «فقد كذَّبتم» is resumptive, and the clause «فسوف يكون» is conjoined to the resumptive clause; the noun of «يكون» is the pronoun of the punishment.
